The structured bodice includes elegant boning for a cinched, sculpted silhouette, finished with a statement metal V trim at the bust for that high-fashion feel. Designed in a dreamy cream hue that flatters every skin tone, this limited edition top pairs perfectly with tailored pants, satin skirts or denim for a look that goes from date night to cocktail hour with ease. The soft cream shade adds timeless elegance while staying fresh and feminine for summer and beyond.
